cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.

stats.notes: No Common Data Set found: UC Merced's Center for Institutional Effectiveness site has no Common Data Set page and the newest CDS PDFs a web search found there are for 2022-23, so items found only in a CDS (residency and international splits, wait-list, GPA, admission factors) are not added. Figures are IPEDS fall 2024 entering-class counts via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal (31,928 applied, 28,906 admitted, 2,093 enrolled), matching College Navigator's 91% admitted / 7% yield. Undergraduate enrollment 8,372 and 42 nonresident undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2024 (EF2024). UC campuses are test-blind (UC Merced: SAT/ACT not used), so there are no test scores.

stats_extra.notes: Fall 2026 first-year class from UC Admissions (overall admit rate 94.7%); middle 25%-75% high school GPA of admits 3.57-4.16. UC Merced's newsroom (Aug 26, 2026) reports a record 2,705 first-year students enrolled in fall 2026, up from 1,982 in fall 2025, and says official numbers follow the September census, so the enrolled count is not entered here.
